start: A gym member: member of a gym that has its own colour, tone or logo; app closed

steps.action: Open the app
user_sees: The gym's logo full-screen on the gym's background colour, the gym's name small under it
It eases in, holds under a second and fades away by itself
must_not: Another gym's logo or name
An empty coloured screen while the logo loads (the name must stand large until then)

steps.action: Wait about a second and a half
user_sees: The app's first screen, already in the gym's colours
must_not: The logo screen staying up
A flash of the plain MettleUp colours after it goes

start: A gym member: no gym yet; has the join code of a gym that has its own look

steps.action: Join the gym with its code
user_sees: Full-screen: 'WELCOME TO' and the gym's name, with the logo once it has loaded
It stays about two seconds
must_not: The welcome shown over a workout that is open
The short launch version with no welcome words

steps.action: Wait
user_sees: The app drawn again in the gym's name and colours
must_not: The app left in the old colours until the next launch

start: A gym member: member of a gym with no colour, tone or logo (or a gym whose plan does not include branding), or of no gym

steps.action: Open the app
user_sees: The app's first screen straight away, in MettleUp's own look
must_not: A full-screen logo or gym name for a gym with no look of its own
A blank full-screen pause

steps.action: In a branded gym, open the app with no internet and a logo that was never fetched
user_sees: The gym's name large, in the middle
must_not: A broken-picture mark
An empty screen for the whole second

start: A gym member: member of a branded gym

steps.action: Open the app and tap the logo screen at once
user_sees: It goes straight away
must_not: The tap going through to a button underneath
The logo screen coming back a moment later

steps.action: Turn on the phone's 'Remove animations', open the app again
user_sees: The logo simply shows and goes, no fade or scale
must_not: The logo screen never going away

steps.action: Leave the gym, close and open the app
user_sees: No logo screen
must_not: The old gym's logo on launch after leaving

steps.action: While a workout is open, the gym changes its logo
user_sees: Nothing changes now; the next launch opens with the new logo
must_not: A full-screen logo over the open workout
A running rest timer reset by the re-draw

steps.action: Join gym B
user_sees: Gym B's welcome with gym B's name and logo
must_not: Gym A's logo or name, even for a moment
A logo shown from a saved copy that belongs to another gym

steps.action: Close and open the app
user_sees: Gym B's logo screen
must_not: Gym A's logo
Anything on this screen beyond the gym name and logo (no member name, no plan, no dues)
